'''Holowan Mechanicals''' ('''HM'''), also known as '''Holowan Mechanicals: The Friendly Technology People''',<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a subsidiary of [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]]. The company was notable for manufacturing the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] though it actually bought the blueprints from [[Phlut Design Systems/Legends|Phlut Design Systems]] after it declared bankruptcy following its takeover by the larger [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].

Holowan Mechanicals was responsible for manufacturing the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], the deadly droid bodyguards of the feared [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the company went on to build the infamous IG-series assassin droids including [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]], [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]], [[IG-97 battle droid|IG-97]] and the [[IG-110 lightsaber droid|IG-110 Lightsaber Droid]].
